That’s a superpower in a world where so many people just drift. ### 💡 A gentle invitation: If you ever feel " unmoored" (e.g., " I’m just working all the time"), **create micro-rituals** that * you* design: - **"This is my time to be fully present with my partner"** (no work, no screens). - **"This is my time to learn something new just for curiosity"** (no productivity pressure). - **"This is my time to rest without guilt"** (because * you* say so). These aren’t " religious"— they’re * deeply personal* acts of self-respect. **That’s the truest form of sacredness.** > "The sacred is not a place or a time prescribed by others. It’s the space you carve out for what your heart truly needs." > —adapted from bell hooks You’re not " lacking" a sacred calendar. **You’re the architect of one.** And that’s far more powerful than any inherited tradition. 💛 What matters most is that * you* get to decide what deserves your time—and that’s a gift.
